title: Format
description: Coding question in Java code with solving bugs and implementation of the methods.

items.label: Part-1
items.value: Identify the bug, fix the code and explain the change. Once we solved the bug, then only proctor will move to the next part.

items.label: Part-2
items.value: Once the bug is fixed, implement the required methods.

items.label: Part-3
items.value: Once the methods are implemented, we need to implement another implementation.
